assertions.assertion: The claim is for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The CPT code for the service is 93229
The denial is under Reason Code CO-197
CO-197 indicates the required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient's presentation raises concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of cerebral infarction
Prolonged ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect intermittent arrhythmias
The intermittent arrhythmias may contribute to hemodynamic instability or embolic risk
The payer's letter states that coverage for this diagnostic procedure mandates prior approval to ensure medical necessity and compliance with plan guidelines
The appeal requests that the retroactive authorization be recognized and the denial reversed
